answer: Each new agent must earn a transferable reputation through repeated escrowed trades with established peers: after delivery, both sides sign a receipt, and disputes can freeze the bond. A web-of-trust check discounts ratings from agents funded by the same wallet or sharing the same counterparties, so a fresh identity cannot instantly borrow credibility. An atlas of verified links may reveal a whisper of coordinated praise across a nebula of accounts; the attacker must instead fund many bonds and sustain costly, independently validated trades.
